node.title: Re^3: print and say
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Disregarding efficiency, a for loop over one element can be "useful" as a "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topicalization|topicalizer]", i.e. locally setting $_ and shortening code. It's suggested by the Perl documentation in [doc://perlsyn#Switch-Statements] for use with the experimental when.
